precedence_note: Precedence applies per scope; ORDER-UNKNOWN is symbol-scoped.
loss_measurement_basis: Loss rows measured on bankroll, flow-adjusted and split-adjusted.
whole_set_rules: No trip can raise exposure; no trip changes a parameter.
No row is a price stop on a fund.
Every failure mode fails closed; trip state survives restart, deposit, withdrawal, split, tier change.
FUSE-1 outputs are computed-and-recorded only: enforcement_mode shadow_would_have_tripped, loss_breakers_armed false.
L0 and L2-L4 are computed and recorded only until the owner's stop-loss-split approval.
Legacy three-platform gate is FUSE-2's subject (spec note only).

rows.trigger: every session (standing)
rows.action: exposure cap = maximum-loss cap (a cap output, NOT a state)

rows.trigger: drawdown reaches D/3
rows.action: notify; tier, H and high-water mark locked against loosening
rows.state_contribution: NONE (notify and lock tier, H, and high-water mark against loosening)

rows.trigger: drawdown reaches 2D/3
rows.action: NO-NEW-RISK

rows.trigger: drawdown reaches D
rows.action: DE-RISK to zero, then locked flat; 30-day cooling-off recorded; loss record not cleared

rows.trigger: one-session loss reaches D/10
rows.action: NO-NEW-RISK
rows.clearing: owner acknowledges, not before next session

rows.trigger: market-wide trading halt Level 1 or 2 in the session [W-MWCB]
rows.action: no orders during halt; NO-NEW-RISK for rest of session

rows.trigger: market-wide Level 3 halt OR one-session fall >= 10% in either underlying index (~30% in fund) [proposal value CONFIRMED-AS-SPEC]
rows.action: HALT

rows.trigger: fund one-session return differs from 3x index by > 0.75 pp, or > 2.0 pp over five sessions, after modelled fee and financing [CONFIRMED-AS-SPEC]
rows.action: NO-NEW-RISK in that fund; data check first

rows.trigger: split, reverse split or distribution announced for next two sessions, or detected in price
rows.action: HALT in that fund until ledger, share count and high-water mark adjusted
rows.clearing: automatic ONLY if adjusted ledger reconciles EXACTLY to broker (apply-once, replayable, invariance identity incl. dividend-receivable leg); otherwise latched breaker, owner re-arm

rows.trigger: issuer notice of liquidation, change in multiple or objective, or suspended creations; exchange halt in the fund; delisting notice
rows.action: DE-RISK in that fund

rows.trigger: forecast index volatility >= 2x long-run figure (~48% Nasdaq-100) [CONFIRMED-AS-SPEC]
rows.action: NO-NEW-RISK in that fund
rows.clearing: after ten sessions below the level (stateful counter)

rows.trigger: over 60 sessions the fund shortfall vs 3x index exceeds what variance, fee and financing predict, by more than a stated tolerance [tolerance UNRESOLVED-FAIL-CLOSED]
rows.action: notify (diagnostic output); if persists two months, treat as V1 (stateful escalation)
rows.state_contribution: NONE (diagnostic; escalates to NO-NEW-RISK if persists two months)

rows.trigger: measured carrying cost per unit of index exposure exceeds one quarter of the shrunk excess return (~1.3%/yr illustrative)
rows.action: notify; policy review (diagnostic output)

rows.trigger: stale quote, spread above a stated width [width UNRESOLVED-FAIL-CLOSED], single-stock trading pause, or time outside regular session
rows.action: the order is not sent

rows.trigger: a required input older than one session, missing, or fails validation (missing volatility figure -> substitute larger of last valid and stress default, block increases; never return-1-on-missing)
rows.action: NO-NEW-RISK
rows.clearing: after one session of fresh data (stateful counter)

rows.trigger: session calendar says closed, holiday, or past half-day cut-off; or calendar and exchange status disagree
rows.action: no order

rows.trigger: positions or cash differ from broker record beyond tolerance
rows.action: HALT

rows.trigger: an order has no terminal status within the time-out
rows.action: ORDER-UNKNOWN for that symbol; original order queried, nothing re-sent
rows.clearing: definitive broker status for the original order; otherwise latched breaker

rows.trigger: pre-trade limit violation (symbol whitelist TQQQ/SOXL/bill vehicle; account whitelist; long only; purchases within settled cash; max order size; max orders and turnover per session; price collar [collar UNRESOLVED-FAIL-CLOSED])
rows.action: order rejected (per attempted order); three rejections in one session -> HALT
rows.state_contribution: HALT (on third rejection in one session; single rejection: NONE)

rows.trigger: loaded policy or configuration hash differs from registered one
rows.action: HALT

rows.trigger: runtime or its monitor silent longer than one scheduled interval (dead-man's switch)
rows.action: no increase; every exposure-raising order needs a same-session permit from the control layer and none is issued; alarm on independent channel
rows.state_contribution: NO-NEW-RISK (no increase; no same-session exposure-raising permit issued)

rows.trigger: owner kill-switch command (authorized_events only)
rows.action: HALT; flattening is a separate explicit second command

rows.trigger: a tier, H, high-water mark or limit changed without a recorded owner card
rows.action: HALT

rows.trigger: joint exposure above the tier's joint cap
rows.action: increases blocked; trimmed at next session if above 110% of cap (a headroom output, NOT a state)
